thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: service=inference-east-prod metric=p99_latency threshold=1200ms count=5
alice: ack, I'm oncall. diving in.
bob: thx ack. grabbing telemetry now. can you check if this is regional or global?
alice: looks regional - eu-west nodes showing p99 ~1500ms, us-east fine.
carol: got the runtime traces — hotpath shows KV cache miss spike + longer queuing on sidecar batcher.
dave: any customer impact reported? support queue quiet so far. erin can you confirm?
erin: no customer tickets yet, but product telemetry shows degraded latency for some interactive flows. pinged CS to proactively monitor.
bob: checking infra: autoscaler didn't trigger because node utilization below 70%. suspect hotkey + small batches stalling K/V.
alice: running quick mitigation: will set routing policy to prefer fallback model with smaller context size for eu-west and enable burst capacity.
alice: `redwoodctl routing set --region eu-west --policy prefer:fallback-smallctx --duration 10m`
carol: also bumping sidecar batcher max concurrency on eu-west to 8 -> 16 to flush backlog.
carol: `kubectl -n runtime scale deploy/sidecar-batcher-eu --replicas=4`
bob: scaling GPU pool as a safety: `gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize ig-inference-eu 6` (triggering graceful attach)
dave: good. if fallback works we should avoid PD escalations. keep PD notes.
alice: incident-bot: note - applied routing fallback + batcher scale at t+3m
incident-bot: Note recorded in incident log: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-4321
erin: CS confirms two customers saw slow UI during 15:12-15:18 UTC but no errors. filing follow-up.
carol: metrics look better after actions: p99 down to ~800ms in eu-west, queue depth decreasing.
bob: still seeing a couple noisy hosts with high kernel-sched wait, marking for repro.
dave: do we want to roll a quick restart on sidecar v2 on those hosts?
alice: scheduling rolling restart on 2 affected nodes to avoid mass disruption.
alice: `for node in nodeA nodeB; do kubectl drain $node && kubectl uncordon $node; done` (one at a time)
erin: FYI CS wants a short customer note if it flares again.
bob: extracting flamegraph for one noisy container and will upload to the incident doc.
carol: root cause hypothesis: sudden hotkey workload + small batch sizes causing KV cache thrash + queuing; autoscaler didn't kick due to util pattern.
dave: action items: 1) add hotkey detection to autoscaler trigger 2) add KV cache miss alert 3) runbook update for routing fallback steps 4) postmortem if repeats.
alice: I'll own runbook update and hotkey trigger ticket.
bob: I'll own the flaky host investigation and autoscaler tweak.
carol: I'll add KV-miss alert + test scenario to perf-suite.
erin: I'll draft a customer-facing note template and coordinate with CS.
alice: incident-bot: marking thread resolved, no active PD alerts. follow-up meeting at 11:00 UTC tomorrow for debrief.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert resolved by user alice (ack cleared)
alice: thanks team. short debrief later — please add any logs/links to the incident doc. :thumbsup:
